 Did you miss the debut of UFC 334 "Countdown" or just want to watch it again? Check out the co-main event preview now.
 The segment takes a special look at the women’s bantamweight title fight between champion Kayla Harrison (19-1 MMA, 3-0 UFC) and former two-division champ Amanda Nunes (23-5 MMA, 16-2 UFC). Harrison is returning after a lengthy layoff due to surgery. Nunes is coming out of retirement to try to recapture a title.
 UFC 334 (Paramount+) takes place Saturday at Madison Square Garden in New York. "Countdown" goes behind the scenes with the two fighters, and you can watch the full segment above. And don't miss the entire episode in the video below.
 Watch UFC 334 with Paramount+
